name: Telgesinus

attributes.attribute: a Welsh hero who is one and the same as the bard Taliesin
instructed the magician Merlin in the secret ways of the universe

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Telgesinus is a Welsh hero. A Welsh text uses this name for the great bard Taliesin. Taliesin was the one who taught the magician Merlin the secret ways of the universe.

okr.objective: Describe Telgesinus, a name for the bard Taliesin.
key_results: One Welsh text gives this name to the great bard Taliesin.
Thus named, Taliesin instructed the magician Merlin in the secret ways of the universe.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
